\newcommand{\duallayerbox}[2]{%
  \begingroup
  \settowidth{\dlboxwidth}{\strut #1}%
  \settoheight{\dlboxheight}{\strut #1}%
  \settodepth{\dlboxdepth}{\strut #1}%

\section*{Multiple Choice (10 marks)}
\begin{enumerate}[label=\arabic*.]
\item \duallayerbox{Which of the following is true of the assessment of power in the arms?}{Which MRC grade represents movement only against gravity?}
\begin{enumerate}[label=(\alph*)]
    \item Extension at the elbow is produced by the biceps muscle
    \item Grade 3/5 (MRC scale) represents movement of the arm only when gravity is eliminated
    \item Grade 2/5 power represents movement of the arm only against gravity.
    \item The brachioradialis muscle is responsible for shoulder abduction
    \item Grade 0/5 power represents full range of motion with resistance
\end{enumerate}
\item \duallayerbox{The influence of genetics on longevity is estimated to be about}{The proportion of lifespan variation due to environment is about}
\begin{enumerate}[label=(\alph*)]
    \item 33\%
    \item 40\%
    \item 60\%
    \item 20\%
    \item 80\%
\end{enumerate}
\item \duallayerbox{The World Health Organization recommends zinc supplements for which groups of people?}{Which group is most commonly advised to take calcium supplements?}
\begin{enumerate}[label=(\alph*)]
    \item Men with high physical activity levels
    \item All women over the age of 50
    \item All children in high income areas with low prevalence of stunting
    \item Elderly people with low incomes
    \item Adolescents in high-stress environments
\end{enumerate}
\item \duallayerbox{The coronal suture joins the}{The sagittal suture joins the}
\begin{enumerate}[label=(\alph*)]
    \item parietal, squamous temporal and greater wing of the sphenoid.
    \item left and right parietal bones.
    \item parietal and sphenoid bones.
    \item frontal and occipital bones.
    \item squamous temporal and greater wing of the sphenoid.
\end{enumerate}
\item \duallayerbox{Which of the following appears to lower bad cholesterol?}{Which of the following is a fat-soluble antioxidant vitamin?}
\begin{enumerate}[label=(\alph*)]
    \item Vitamin E
    \item Vitamin A
    \item Thiamine
    \item Niacin
    \item Vitamin B12
\end{enumerate}
\end{enumerate}

\section*{True / False (10 marks)}
\textit{Answer True or False}
\begin{enumerate}[label=\arabic*.]
\setcounter{enumi}{5}
\item True or False: \duallayerbox{Parvoviruses only replicate in dividing cells, which limits their ability to infect non-dividing tissues.}{Parvoviruses efficiently replicate in non-dividing cells throughout the body.}
\item True or False: \duallayerbox{Among the various factors studied, behavioral factors have received significant research support for their link to social support and health.}{Social support has been shown to influence health partly through its effects on health-related behaviors.}
\item True or False: \duallayerbox{Enzyme assays are primarily used to diagnose carriers of Huntington's disease based on genetic mutations.}{Genetic testing is primarily used to diagnose carriers of Huntington's disease based on DNA mutations.}
\item True or False: \duallayerbox{People with no previous history of mental health issues are more likely to experience depression after a loss.}{People with a previous history of depression are more likely to experience depression after a loss.}
\item True or False: The cardiac cycle includes the phases of systole, diastole, and rest, which are critical for blood circulation.
\end{enumerate}
